_comment: Stuffy Doll + Guilty Conscience, design step 5 (docs/design/damage-reflection-pipeline.md 3, 10).
Cast GC ({W}) on the Doll, then the Doll's {T} ping: the Doll deals 1 to itself, so its reflection
deals 1 to the opponent AND GC deals 1 back to the Doll -- every reflected point raises another GC
trigger, and the loop iterates for real until the opponent is dead (~40 resolutions from 20, far
below the 65,536 cap). The host is a SEARCHED variant: a Mogg Maniac is a second legal host, and GC
there does not kill. Without GC the ping deals 1.
